block.title: The full C-to-IR lowering pipeline runs in Gallina through OCaml and λANF
block.p: The remaining Prolog compiler passes now live in pure, zero-axiom Gallina under nanofil/rocq/frontend, porting launder.pl, c_lower.pl, and c_layouts.pl into seven modules: CLaunder.v, CLowerState.v, CLowerInit.v, CLowerAsm.v, CLowerBuiltins.v, CLower.v, and CLayouts.v. Together with the preprocessor, lexer, parser, IEEE 754 engine, and type checker, the extracted OCaml driver main.ml now compiles C source files directly through Compile.v to Fil-C x86-64 assembly with zero Prolog in the path.

On swa, the OCaml extraction matches SWI-Prolog byte-for-byte on both pp-cc-ir (including every provenance context/2 record) and pp-cc-layouts across all 482 preprocessed C test fixtures and Fil-C glibc system headers (349 compiled, 133 matching diagnostics, zero diffs), including all 27 <immintrin.h> vector tests and userland-idioms.c. Compiling C programs end-to-end with nanofil-frontend --allocated pp-cc-asm, assembling with GNU as, linking with filcc, and running the resulting binaries passed on all 23 tested standalone programs, including five AVX2 vector suites (vector-avx2-2.c through vector-avx2-6.c) and vector-sse-arith.c.

CertiRocq taps the full frontend, type checker, laundering, lowering, and layout pipeline in Drive.v with -O 1 --anf-variant 8 into 141,098 lines of λANF. AnfLower.v lowers those 44,455 functions into 9,867 checked nanofil IR functions, and nanofil-backend compile-allocated emits 19,781,470 lines of Fil-C x86-64 assembly that link into a memory-safe anf-frontend binary in 13 seconds. The λANF Fil-C binary matches OCaml byte-for-byte across all 487 C fixtures (lex, parse, cc-ir, and cc-layouts), all 20 Fil-C glibc headers, and 12 heavy preprocessed programs under a 4096-word nursery with FUGC_SCRIBBLE=1 FUGC_VERIFY=1 (490,572 minor collections without traps).

claim.p: The extracted OCaml frontend matches SWI-Prolog byte-for-byte across all eight differential suites (lex 487/487, parse 480/480, c23 9/9, pp 4/4, ieee 2366/2366, types 306/306, cc-ir 306/306, and layouts 306/306), and all 19 frontend .v files pass the parse.sh grammar round-trip check.
Across 248 preprocessed C programs under tests/c/prog/ (241 compiled into 5,107 IR items, 7 errors), both Gallina builds outpace SWI-Prolog while producing identical IR and layout output.

metrics.baseline: SWI-Prolog pp+cc-ir on 248 preprocessed C programs (5,107 IR items, swa, best of 3)
